column1: # Members of the `play` profile in addition to every member of `fixed` (decision G30, 2026-11-03: the port diverges from the original on
# purpose; `play` is the app default, `fixed` stays hangs and faults only, `original` stays every switch at 1 and the test oracle).
# Columns as re/port/defect_profiles.tsv: switch value decision_id reason. A switch listed here must not also be in defect_profiles.tsv.

column4: reason
sinScaled interpolates index 255 towards the dword after g_sinTable (never written, 0): it uses entry 255 itself, a flat last segment (model_defects #10)
the 10-entry shot power cache key leaves out the putt argument, so a putt can return a full-shot result: a putt bypasses the cache (model_defects #18)
the strict-scan flag is never cleared within a target search, so once set every later landing is scanned strict: it is cleared before each landing's test (model_defects #37)
the hazard cell passed to the golfer thoughts is y * 50 + x against the grids' x * 50 + y: it is passed in grid order (model_defects #38)
two missed-shot exits skip restoring the named golfer's skill mask: it is restored on those exits too (model_defects #39)
g_namedStoryIndex stored as the 50-byte story id 2k of the opening file k (its readers' unit), not the 0x64-byte slot number k
a theme .pro golfer's ten skill bytes and their sum go into its own pro record, not the next one
cash stored into the int16 month history and ledger entry is saturated to -32768..32767 instead of wrapping
opening the financial report no longer writes each drawn year's column sum into the saved ledger row
per-tile thought counters g_tileMoodUp / g_tileMoodDown saturate at 255 instead of wrapping to 0
the par re-derivation walks hole records 1..18 once each instead of one record 18 times
no free walker record: spawn nothing instead of writing over g_editQueueX
at most 32 ball screen points appended
corner level stops at 0 / 255 and the key-0x58 reset writes all 51 bytes
story cache text cut to the 0x100-byte field
name and third text cut to their stack slots
bulletin event id of 22 or more ignored
the title menu's exit is selected only inside its own 0x3a x 0x39 icon, not over the 0x140 x 0x50 nearest-point area around the icon's corner
the theme-pack screen draws no sixth column cell (the original draws one at a stack word it never writes: a yellow cell left of the list on the current theme's row)
Gary Golf follows the cursor tile only up to the 50 x 50 grid's edge (the cursor tile is clamped for his walk target) and no walker's step leaves the grid
a golfer's walking step is clamped to the 50 x 50 grid, so no golfer (Gary Golf included) walks past the edge of the land

every camera writer that follows a golfer, walker, ball or photo, or offsets from a hole or object, clamps the camera tile to 0..0x31 like the arrow-key and edge-pan cases, so the view centre stays on the map

the HUD panels (build palette, terrain toolbar, buildings, amenities, employee and golfer panels) draw a hovered control's tip after more than 3 frames on it (about 0.37 s) instead of more than 10 (about 1.0 s): the original's `cmp [g_ui_5aa554], 0xa` at 0x00433257 / 0x004338ff and the same compare in the five other panels

worldToScreen's on-screen test (playSoundAt's RNG draw, the story advances of golfers on screen) covers the host's wide view (W = window width * 600 / height, the view block's word): the same share of the view as the original's 800 of its own, centred; the original tests 800 only

tileToScreen's x window (the tiles whose scenery buildSceneSprites queues) covers the wide view the same way, so the side columns get their trees and objects; the original queues only x -0x40 .. 0x35f

the title menu starts each pass with no item selected, not item 1 (Start New Game), until the cursor nears an item (ML+0x11a95..ML+0x11aad): no item is lit on the first frame and a click away from every item starts nothing
a labelled title-menu item is chosen only with the cursor inside its button art box (showTitleScreen 0x0043d054..0x0043d129), not within distance 0xa0 of its text centre (ML+0x11aaf..ML+0x11ae1)
Esc on the world map acts as its Back button (hot 3: 0x00470634); the original never reads the key words there
Esc on the buy-land screen acts as Done (0x004592e7); the original never reads the key words there
Esc in the character editor acts as a press on Exit (case 19, 0x00439d8f..0x00439dba); the original never reads the key words there
Esc in the editor's look picker acts as its cancel (a right click: 0x0043857d)
Esc on a popup without key handling (flag4 0: Preferences, the tournament par list; 0x0046db31 skips the key block) acts as its close button (0x0046dcdf -> 0x0046dd86)
Esc in the skill point dialog acts as a click on OK (0x0045f644; the points-left popup when points remain)

a press the widescreen host marked as made where a moved HUD panel used to be (the course shows there; view block word +4) takes the frame's world path (0x0041e4b8) instead of the System menu / panel tests (0x0041e400..0x0041e4b2)

Ctrl+Z undoes the newest course edit step (the edits of one left press): every setGrids edit (0x0040a130) is journalled with the code / refund it overwrote, and the host's undo request (view block word +8) runs demolishObject (0x0040a4e0, the original's right-click undo: previous content back, price refunded) on the step's tiles, newest first, then restores each tile's earlier record
